title: 日本ダービーの後に・追いついた！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower pulls out all the stops at the Japanese Derby and beats Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she can't let up just because she managed to win this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the long-distance Kikuka Sho, where she will face off against Mihono Bourbon once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This upcoming race will be make-or-break for a stayer like Rice Shower, so it's back to training for us.
